text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 235 million markka median forecast for Finnish mining and metals group Outokumpu Oy's January-April profit before extraordinary items and tax.
(Profit forecasts by 10 analysts, EPS by six analysts).
Outokumpu's results are due on June 5 at 1000/0800 GMT.
In January-April 1996, Outokumpu posted a 305 million markka profit before extraordinary items and tax.
In March, CEO Jyrki Juusela said he expected improved financial results this year.
The median of seven analysts' forecasts for Outokumpu's full-year 1997 profit before extras and tax was 1.05 billion markka (mean 982 million) in a 616 million to 1.24 billion markka range.
In 1996, Outokumpu's profit was 229 million markka.

Contributors to the survey were AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, Carnegie Securities, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, FSB Securities, Handelsbanken, Merita Securities and Opstock Securities.
